comment: Deleted #15 Art. 93 VE (OTHER_LAW): the reference is Art. 93 VE-ZPO, an article of the 2003 preliminary draft (Vorentwurf) of the federal ZPO. The proposal also cut the abbreviation before -ZPO. A draft act is not law in force, so OTHER_LAW does not fit; an abbreviation follows the number, so BARE_ARTICLE does not fit. Guideline gap: article of a draft federal act cited with an abbreviation (VE-ZPO, E-ZPO). Left without span.
